title: Mere ammu
body:
Haye Sakina(sa) Haaye Abbas(as) .. (2)
Sar pe saaya mere baba ka salaamat rehta
Mere Ammu k agar baazu salaamat rehte
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kaise gauhar mere kaano se utaare jaate
Kaise mumkin tha tamache mujhe maare jaate
Shaame gham aati nahi na mera daaman jalta
Mere Ammu.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aise baazaaro mein lagte nahi pathar mujhko
Maangte kaise kaneezi mein sitamgar mujhko
Paani is tarha dikhakar na bahaya jaata
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khaak par kuze ulatkar nahi rakhkhe hote
Sehme bachche yu sare neher na pyaase hote
Teer aise na mere mashk pe aaker lagta
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Haaye ye khaak ka bistar na bichaauna hota
Mere sone k liye baba ka seena hota
Maarkar naize nahi mujhko jagayaa jaata
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mai agar rou'n to rone na diya jaaye mujhe
Aur na rou'n to rulaate hain jafaaye karke
Is tarha dohra sitam mujhpe na tuta hota
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aise rassi na gale mein mere baandhi jaati
Aise kaanto pe na paidal ye safar mai karti
Pushte naaqa se na mujhko yu giraaya jaata
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shaam se ab bhi ye "Salman" hawa aati hai
Aisa lagta hai k IMRAN sada aati hai
Mera zindaa'n k andhere mein na marqad banta
Mere Ammu k agar baazu salaamat rehte
Sar pe saaya mere baba ka salaamat rehta
Mere Ammu k agar baazu salaamat rehte
